memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, drives auto-rickshaw daily, no assistance needed.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative), no cognitive concerns.
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 s (normal).
medicines: 8 regular (clobetasol cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg OD, apixaban 5 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD) – polypharmacy, review Beers.
mood: Reports good mood, denies sadness or anxiety.
carers: Main carer: spouse, relationship spouse.
goals: "I want to keep driving my auto-rickshaw without pain."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Still drives auto-rickshaw, reports occasional knee discomfort after long walks.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative) – stable.
falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait slightly antalgic on right, TUG 11 s (normal).
medicines: 8 regular – polypharmacy, continue review.
mood: Mild frustration about knee pain, denies depression.
carers: Main carer: spouse, relationship spouse.
goals: "I want to keep working without knee pain limiting my shifts."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
INR 2.4 (target 2-3) – on apixaban? Actually INR measured due to occasional warfarin thought; value within range.
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0).
Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No new ST-T changes. Prior atrial fibrillation not seen; likely controlled on apixaban.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve noticed a small red patch on my elbow that’s itchy and slightly scaly. It’s been there for about two weeks.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Refer to Dermatology, Sunrise Specialist Centre, for evaluation of refractory plaque psoriasis and possible biologic therapy. Include recent labs and medication list.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dermatology review: Plaque psoriasis moderate, PASI 8. Continue topical steroids and methotrexate. Add phototherapy twice weekly. No biologic needed at this time.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream BD topical
calcipotriol ointment OD topical
methotrexate 7.5 mg PO weekly
folic acid 5 mg PO daily
apixaban 5 mg PO BD
bisoprolol 2.5 mg PO OD
levetiracetam 500 mg PO BD
lamotrigine 50 mg PO BD
add: phototherapy sessions twice weekly (prescribed as order)

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Driving auto-rickshaw, reports reduced elbow itch after phototherapy; knee pain unchanged.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative) – annual screen done, stable.
falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 s (normal).
medicines: 8 regular – polypharmacy, discuss possible methotrexate dose reduction if LFTs rise.
mood: Reports improved mood with skin improvement.
carers: Main carer: spouse, relationship spouse.
goals: "I want to keep my skin clear enough to work without embarrassment."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: EEG: Background rhythm normal, no epileptiform discharges. No spikes or sharp waves. Stable epilepsy medication effect.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2026-03-20 10:30 AM with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for routine follow-up.

function: Driving auto-rickshaw, reports occasional palpitations after long rides; otherwise ADLs independent.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative) – stable.
falls: 0 falls last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 s (normal).
medicines: Currently on apixaban, bisoprolol, levetiracetam, lamotrigine, methotrexate, folic acid, topicals. Discuss stroke prevention in AF.
mood: Reports mild anxiety about palpitations.
carers: Main carer: spouse, relationship spouse.
goals: "I want to feel my heart steady while working."
